name: CertChain
tagline: Decentralized certificate verification on Ethereum + IPFS
description: A hybrid on-chain/off-chain decentralized application for issuing and verifying academic certificates. Certificate metadata is hashed and recorded on the Ethereum blockchain, while certificate files are stored through IPFS via Pinata — creating a tamper-evident, independently verifiable credential system.
problem: Traditional academic certificates are difficult to verify at scale and can be vulnerable to forgery or unauthorized modification.
solution: A decentralized certificate issuance and verification workflow using Ethereum smart contracts for hash storage and IPFS for file persistence.

name: Brevitus Technology
tagline: Modern web platform for courses, internships, and events
description: Contributed to a feature-rich web platform during a 3-month internship, building responsive interfaces and interactive user experiences for a platform offering courses, internships, and technical events.
problem: Users needed a clean, fast, and engaging platform to discover and access courses, internship opportunities, and technical events.
solution: Built responsive UI components and interactive sections using Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion.

name: FaceMesh AI
tagline: Real-time facial landmark tracking in the browser
description: Browser-based real-time facial landmark tracking using MediaPipe Face Mesh and TensorFlow.js. Maps dense facial topology directly on the client — no server round-trips required.

name: Pneumo-AI
tagline: Chest X-ray classification with VGG19 transfer learning
description: End-to-end deep learning application for chest X-ray classification (NORMAL / PNEUMONIA) using CNN-based VGG19 transfer learning with an interactive Streamlit interface for predictions and visual analytics.

name: Customer Churn Prediction
tagline: ML churn prediction with interactive React analytics dashboard
description: ML-based customer churn prediction combined with a React analytics dashboard for risk scoring and data visualization.
